summary.en: Whole – part – whole: three strands (or two) fork from the spine and each ends in a glass card; each card is enlarged in turn in place on its strand, its rows arriving, the next growing as the previous shrinks; then all of them again and a sub-line. One card is a single pass: one strand straight into it, already large, its rows read.
summary.zh: 总–分–总：主干分出三根（或两根）细丝，各挂一张玻璃卡；每张卡依次在细丝上原地放大、各行出现，下一张放大时上一张同时缩小；最后全部一起，再加一句副标题。只有一张卡时一遍过：一根细丝直连到已经放大的卡，读完各行。

fits: What the product keeps between tasks (memory, decisions, files): up to three, shown together and one by one, or one shown on its own.
notFor: More than three things; things that are not lists; one card that needs a sentence of its own while open (one card is read under the scene's caption).

intent.en: Show the parts and keep the whole: up to three things the product keeps, each read in turn.
intent.zh: 看部分、留住整体：产品保存的东西（最多三样），一样样读。

content.en: Two captions; one to three cards, each with a title, a sub-line and 1–3 rows (≤ 34 characters / 17 Chinese characters); optional: the tangle the strands are pulled out of, a caption per open card (two or three cards), a line flowing into a card, a new task starting from a card; rows up to 5 with the flowed line.
content.zh: 两句字幕；一到三张卡，各有标题、副标题和 1–3 行（≤ 34 字符 / 17 个汉字）；可选：开头线团拽成几股、每张卡放大时的章节句（两张或三张卡时）、一句话顺线流进卡、从卡开工的新任务行；连流进的那句最多 5 行。

fits.zh: 产品在任务之间保存的东西（记忆、决定、文件）：最多三样时先一起再一样样，一样时单独展示。

notFor.zh: 超过三样；不是列表的东西；只有一张卡却要在卡打开时另说一句（一张卡时读的是场景字幕）。

en: The rows are glances (0.8 s each): what a card says is its `say`, read while the card is open; a card without `say` holds for its rows' glances only.

One card is a single pass: it opens already large on one strand, with no whole before or after; its rows are read under the scene's caption, so a card's `say` is refused. Two cards hang at y 435 and 645 and hand over as three do; `day-after-day` needs three cards.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
zh: 卡里的行是扫一眼的（每行 0.8 秒）：一张卡要说的话放在 `say`，卡打开时按读字计时；没给 `say` 的卡只停够各行的扫一眼。
一张卡时一遍过：卡在一根细丝上直接以放大状态出现，前后没有“全部一起”；各行在场景字幕下读，所以不能给卡 `say`。两张卡挂在 y 435 和 645，交接方式同三张；`day-after-day` 要求三张卡。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
